name: AIGO Framework Studio
description:
AIGO Framework Studio is an open-source workspace for structuring and documenting AI governance activities throughout the AI system lifecycle. It provides dedicated workspaces for AI system inventories, governance classification, evaluation records, reviews and approvals, validation checks, risk and control management, monitoring plans, change and incident records, and assurance evidence.

The project helps teams organize governance information, maintain traceable records, and support human review and accountability. Version 1 focuses on structured governance workflows and record management rather than claiming to automate compliance or independently certify AI systems.
why:
AI governance is often discussed through policies and principles, but teams also need practical ways to organize the records and activities that support those principles.

AIGO Framework Studio brings key governance activities into one structured workspace, helping teams document responsibilities, evaluations, risks, controls, review decisions, changes, incidents, and assurance evidence in a more consistent way.

Its lifecycle-oriented approach makes it useful for AI developers, governance practitioners, researchers, and organizations exploring responsible AI practices. As an open-source project, it also offers a foundation for community feedback, experimentation, and future improvements to practical AI governance tooling.

The project is designed to support governance work and human decision-making, not to replace expert judgment, legal review, or independent compliance assessment.
